transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I've been feeling constantly depressed and sad for a really long time now, for about two years and four months. It just feels like this heavy, low mood never lifts, and that's why I finally decided to come in today.
During these past two years and four months, have there been any periods of a few weeks or more where your mood improved significantly, or has this low mood been present almost every single day?

Honestly, there haven't been any periods where I felt better. This low mood has been present almost every single day for the entire two years and four months. It just never seems to lift, not even for a few weeks.
Besides this persistent low mood, have you also been experiencing other symptoms like changes in your appetite, sleep patterns, energy levels, or difficulty with concentration?

Yes, my appetite has been all over the place, and I've actually noticed some significant changes in my weight recently. As for my sleep, energy levels, or concentration, I'm really not sure and haven't noticed much of a change there.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in almost all of the activities that you used to enjoy during this time?
I'm not really sure about that, to be honest. I haven't really noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in my usual activities.
Do you find that this ongoing low mood significantly interferes with your ability to function in your daily responsibilities, such as at work, school, or in your relationships?

To be honest, I'm not really sure and haven't thought much about how it affects my daily responsibilities or relationships. I've just been so focused on dealing with this persistent low mood every single day.
Besides the low mood and appetite changes, have you experienced feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or thoughts about death during these past two years?
No, I haven't really experienced feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt during this time. I also haven't had any thoughts about death.
Have you experienced any persistent feelings of hopelessness or low self-esteem during these past two years?

Yes, I've had a deep, persistent sense of hopelessness and helplessness for the entire two years and four months, feeling like things will never get better. I'm not really sure about having low self-esteem specifically, but the feeling that the future is completely dark has been constant.
Have you noticed that you have been feeling more fatigued or tired than usual, even when you haven't been doing much physically?
No, I haven't particularly noticed feeling unusually tired or fatigued. My energy levels seem pretty much the same as they've always been.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, such as difficulty falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping significantly more than usual?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant changes in my sleep patterns. My sleep has been generally okay, so I don't think that's been an issue for me.
Have you noticed any difficulty with your ability to concentrate, focus on tasks, or make decisions during these past two years?
No, I haven't really noticed any significant issues with my concentration or focus during this time. Making decisions hasn't really been a problem for me either.
